objective: Auditar exclusivamente en READ_ONLY_SQL, usando HRLectura, los principals SQL ya existentes en EDARSAHUB para identificar si existe un writer canónico reutilizable que tenga capacidad efectiva para ALTER sobre dbo.CavaSocios_Socios y REFERENCES sobre dbo.Gobierno_Persona. No crear logins, usuarios, roles, grants, secrets ni modificar esquema. Producir evidencia suficiente para decidir qué principal existente puede alimentar los aliases EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER / EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_PASSWORD sin ampliar privilegios. Si HRLectura no tiene visibilidad suficiente para certificar permisos efectivos de otros principals, devolver BLOCKED_VISIBILITY con evidencia exacta en vez de inferir.
acceptance: confirmar identidad de conexión DB_NAME/SUSER_SNAME/USER_NAME = EDARSAHUB/HRLectura/HRLectura
inventariar principals de base de datos visibles, su tipo, login asociado cuando sea visible, roles y membresías
inventariar grants/denies relevantes a nivel DATABASE, SCHEMA dbo y OBJECT para dbo.CavaSocios_Socios y dbo.Gobierno_Persona
resolver membresías de roles relevantes y distinguir permisos directos de heredados
clasificar candidatos existentes para writer como CERTIFIED_CANDIDATE, INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION o NOT_DETERMINABLE

no considerar GptLectura, GptEscritura, gptread, gptwrite o GPTWRITE como writer canónico salvo evidencia SQL explícita y además documentar que el repositorio los trata como perfiles alternativos/no canónicos
cero DDL, cero DML, cero GRANT, cero DENY, cero CREATE/ALTER/DROP LOGIN/USER/ROLE
constraints: EDARSAHUB SQL Server es la única fuente canónica
usar exclusivamente HRLectura para la auditoría SQL
no usar GptLectura, GptEscritura, gptread, gptwrite, GPTWRITE ni sa para ejecutar la auditoría
no ejecutar Gate12I ni la migración
si la visibilidad de metadata es insuficiente, bloquear con evidencia en vez de adivinar

queries.name: identity_guard
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS db_user, ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login;

queries.name: target_objects_guard
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(o.object_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE o.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios'), OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona')) ORDER BY o.name;

queries.name: visible_database_principals
queries.sql: SELECT dp.principal_id, dp.name AS principal_name, dp.type_desc, dp.authentication_type_desc, dp.default_schema_name, SUSER_SNAME(dp.sid) AS mapped_login_name, dp.create_date, dp.modify_date FROM sys.database_principals dp WHERE dp.principal_id > 4 AND dp.type IN ('S','U','G','R','E','X') ORDER BY dp.type_desc, dp.name;

queries.name: database_role_memberships
queries.sql: SELECT rolep.name AS role_name, rolep.type_desc AS role_type, memberp.name AS member_name, memberp.type_desc AS member_type FROM sys.database_role_members rm JOIN sys.database_principals rolep ON rolep.principal_id=rm.role_principal_id JOIN sys.database_principals memberp ON memberp.principal_id=rm.member_principal_id ORDER BY rolep.name, memberp.name;

queries.name: relevant_explicit_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT grantee.name AS grantee_name, grantee.type_desc AS grantee_type, perm.state_desc, perm.permission_name, perm.class_desc, perm.major_id, CASE WHEN perm.class_desc='DATABASE' THEN DB_NAME() WHEN perm.class_desc='SCHEMA' THEN SCHEMA_NAME(perm.major_id) WHEN perm.class_desc='OBJECT_OR_COLUMN' THEN QUOTENAME(OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(perm.major_id))+'.'+QUOTENAME(OBJECT_NAME(perm.major_id)) ELSE CONVERT(nvarchar(128),perm.major_id) END AS securable_name FROM sys.database_permissions perm JOIN sys.database_principals grantee ON grantee.principal_id=perm.grantee_principal_id WHERE (perm.class_desc='DATABASE' AND perm.permission_name IN ('CONTROL','ALTER','REFERENCES','ALTER ANY SCHEMA')) OR (perm.class_desc='SCHEMA' AND perm.major_id=SCHEMA_ID(N'dbo') AND perm.permission_name IN ('CONTROL','ALTER','REFERENCES')) OR (perm.class_desc='OBJECT_OR_COLUMN' AND perm.major_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona')) AND perm.permission_name IN ('CONTROL','ALTER','REFERENCES')) ORDER BY grantee.name, perm.class_desc, securable_name, perm.permission_name, perm.state_desc;

queries.name: db_owner_members
queries.sql: SELECT memberp.name AS member_name, memberp.type_desc AS member_type, SUSER_SNAME(memberp.sid) AS mapped_login_name FROM sys.database_role_members rm JOIN sys.database_principals rolep ON rolep.principal_id=rm.role_principal_id JOIN sys.database_principals memberp ON memberp.principal_id=rm.member_principal_id WHERE rolep.name=N'db_owner' ORDER BY memberp.name;

queries.name: target_object_owners
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, USER_NAME(s.principal_id) AS schema_owner, o.name AS object_name, USER_NAME(o.principal_id) AS object_owner FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios'), OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona')) ORDER BY o.name;

queries.name: server_principals_visible_mapping
queries.sql: SELECT sp.principal_id, sp.name AS server_principal_name, sp.type_desc, sp.is_disabled, sp.default_database_name, sp.create_date, sp.modify_date FROM sys.server_principals sp WHERE sp.type IN ('S','U','G') ORDER BY sp.type_desc, sp.name;

queries.name: current_hrlectura_permissions_sanity
queries.sql: SELECT HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios',N'OBJECT',N'ALTER') AS hrlectura_can_alter_socios, HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona',N'OBJECT',N'REFERENCES') AS hrlectura_can_reference_persona, IS_ROLEMEMBER(N'db_owner') AS hrlectura_is_db_owner;
